title: app-shell: pin the Studio title-row tenants outside studio-design (slot toggle, PageShell compact row, directory and diagnostics headers) and the counted accent branch
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet. Contract record on PR #37474 (head `884c4bd3`), findings S1, S2, N1 and N4. Follow-up of #37455. Per the maintainer's rule, a simple issue becomes a follow-up card: the behaviour ships, and only its pins are missing.

reach: read at PR #37474 head `884c4bd3` · evidence: read. Each listed site can be deleted with every suite still green.

## What

1. **S1.** The right-slot toggle (`studio-slot-toggle`, drawn when no copilot is served) has no pin in its new home. It appears in one test only, as a name filtered out of a button list.
2. **S2.** Of the five row ends added outside `studio-design/**`, only the list hero row is pinned. The others are:
   - the `PageShell` compact row and its `!embedded` gate;
   - the directory header;
   - the diagnostics header.
3. **N1.** The counted branch in `studioAccent.ts` has no pin. A plain add/remove would pass the same four graphite cases.
4. **N4.** Dark mode has no jsdom pin. It rests on the Chromium readings in the PR body.
5. **N3** (ride along). `PageShell` passes no `divider` prop, so a row with no stats or actions draws a hairline with nothing before it.

## Expected

- Each site in items 1 and 2 has a pin that turns red when the element is deleted, plus its control.
- The accent counter has a two-mount / one-unmount case.
- N3 is fixed or pinned.
